invariants: Canonical ACP initialization, admission, prompt, model selection, permission, cancellation, EOF and shutdown retain every captured SDK field and ordered committed output.
Hung initialization, malformed or pathological input, overlapping prompts and cancellation at publication boundaries terminate owned MCP/subagent/process trees without replacing the first outcome.
Independent multi-process cold sessions and five-profile consumers preserve the child provider contracts and public transport ownership.

A fresh clean frozen complete release gate, all required child contracts, same-scenario Source/native observations and isolated own-Python3.8.10 extracted consumers pass before parent integration. Child counts, historical receipts and browser functional success alone are insufficient.
identity: Pinned Source and exact candidate/input/observer/ZIP hashes bind full raw observations. Only source-backed allocated identity graphs and documented platform mappings may differ; business fields and registration order stay literal.
ownership: Canonical Context/Loader services and per-agent/session mounts own all registrations and resources. Unload, retirement and physical process close remove only owned effects.
ordering: Source-observed event, dispatch, wire and durable sequence is retained through composed journeys. No sorting or dropping fields to hide registration or publication differences.
errors: Refuse missing/stale/altered lanes, unknown imports, changed artifacts and unmatched full observations. Retain the first raw failure and exact existing upstream exceptions; do not add generic normalization or retries.
cancellation: Observe pre-publication, active, pending reply/result and close/disposal cancellation with bounded individual deadlines and final resource ownership, including cold recovery after physical exit.
adaptation: Python3.8.10 and current Windows are the development runtime. Host compatibility is separate from unchanged frontend parity. Win7 certification remains user-deferred; arbitrary unsupported engine/plugin/transport behavior cannot be inferred from finite observations.
open_questions: A1/A2/A3 permissions, controlled MCP stdio/HTTP/SSE mounting, subprocess ACP, teardown/disposal and one measured Windows descendant tree are accepted only under their bounded contracts at 5c0b3c5e. The parent has no complete source-backed contract or integrated acceptance.

Infinite blocked initialization, pathological/oversized streams, full SDK HTTP/TLS/redirect/compression/URL coverage and arbitrary supervisor/Host crash/background Job/terminal/orphan trees remain unaccepted.

Browser startup cancellation, the original fixed-40ms cache test race, Proactor warnings and HTTP 10054 remain unclassified. Complete profile journeys and deferred Win7 are separate unaccepted scopes.
